post.summary:
Activates a client. Ensures an Employer record exists for the supplied
AccountId (creating one if missing) and optionally assigns the
caller-supplied tool packages to the account.
post.description:
Idempotent â€” if an Employer already exists for the AccountId, this method
skips creation and returns the existing EmployerId. Tool-package assignment
is queued via the same job pipeline used by the invitation flow.
            
Note: this method does not currently restore previously-deactivated Employers.
The downstream Employers service filters soft-deleted rows out of all reads,
so an Employer that was Deactivated for this AccountId is invisible here and
a new row would be created. A proper reactivation path requires either a
downstream restore endpoint or an extension to IEmployerHelper.

post.summary:
Deactivates a client by soft-deleting the Employer record bound to the supplied
AccountId. The record is marked as deleted in the Employers service rather
than physically removed.

Sends one or more invitations to clients or account contacts. Recipients can be
supplied directly (account ids, contact ids), pulled from saved lists, or bulk-mailed
via background jobs. Optionally grants tool packages to the invited recipients.

get.summary: Gets an employee group by ID.

Gets employee groups for a given account using OData query options
($filter, $orderby, $top, $skip). OData filters are translated into the underlying
EmployeeGroup search contract and pushed down to the service. The
accountId query parameter is required to scope the search.

Gets employees for a given account using OData query options
($filter, $orderby, $top, $skip). OData filters are translated into the underlying
Employee search contract and pushed down to the service. The accountId
query parameter is required to scope the search to an account owned by the agency.
Retrieves an assignment by its unique identifier.

put.summary: Updates an existing assignment with the provided details.

delete.summary: Deletes an assignment by its unique identifier.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of assignments for the specified organization and agency.

post.summary: Creates a new assignment for the specified employee.

get.summary: Gets a tool package by ID.

Gets tool packages using OData query options ($filter, $orderby, $top, $skip).
OData filters are translated into the underlying ToolPackage search contract and
pushed down to the service.

InviteRequest.description: Payload describing a set of invitations to send to recipients derived from lists, accounts, contacts, or prior invitations.

listIds.description: The IDs of static lists from which recipients should be derived.

accountIds.description: The IDs of accounts to invite directly.

accountContactIds.description: The IDs of account contacts to invite directly.

invitationIds.description: The IDs of existing invitations the send should reference (used for series).

toolPackageIds.description: The IDs of tool packages to attach to the invitation.

portalId.description: The ID of the portal the invitation targets. Required.

actionText.description: The call-to-action text rendered in the email button.

sendFromUser.description: Whether the email should be sent from the acting user rather than a shared sender.

agencyDomainId.description: The ID of the agency mail domain to send from. Falls back to default if not owned by the agency.

type.description: The type of invitation being sent.

bulkReinvite.description: Whether this is a bulk reinvite (processed as a background job).

bulkInviteNew.description: Whether this is a bulk invite for new contacts (processed as a background job).

isSeries.description: Whether this send represents part of an invitation series.

scheduledDate.description: The date/time the invitation should be sent (used for scheduled sends).

fromEmailAddress.description: Optional override for the from-email address. Defaults to the configured notification address.

InviteType.description: The kind of invitation being sent.

ToolPackageResponse.description:
Client-facing tool package response. Feature keys are translated from the underlying
Guid collection to the strongly-typed ToolPackageFeature enum; internal audit
fields are excluded.

id.description: The unique identifier of the tool package.

name.description: The name of the tool package.

agencyId.description: The agency that owns the tool package.

portalId.description: The portal this package is scoped to, if any.

defaultMembership.description: Whether new clients receive this package by default.

allTools.description: Whether the package grants access to all tools.

allContent.description: Whether the package grants access to all content.

features.description: The features this tool package grants, resolved from the underlying feature keys.

members.description: Member assignments for this tool package (populated when the request asked to enrich members).

ToolPackageFeature.description:
Zywave tool/content features that can be granted by a tool package. The enum value is the
stable public identifier exposed by this API; the underlying feature key (Guid) used by the
internal contracts is resolved via ToolPackageFeatureMap.

Payload for creating or updating a tool package. Wraps ToolPackageInfo and
exposes the feature catalog as a strongly-typed ToolPackageFeature enum rather than
raw feature-key Guids.

allContent.description: Whether the package grants access to all content (overrides Features for content access).

inactive.description: Whether the package is inactive (retained but not granted to new members).

features.description: The features this tool package grants access to.
